name: Numeral
description: AI驱动的销售税合规平台，覆盖90多个国家的增值税和商品服务税合规，集成超过40个计费、财务和ERP系统
description_en: AI-driven sales tax compliance platform handling VAT and GST compliance in 90+ countries, integrating with 40+ billing, financial and ERP systems
why_matters: 刚完成1亿美元C轮融资，由Insight Partners领投，Salesforce Ventures等知名投资方参与，解决跨市场销售税合规这一日益复杂的运营挑战
why_matters_en: Closed $100M Series C led by Insight Partners with Salesforce Ventures participating, addressing increasingly complex cross-market sales tax compliance operational challenges
latest_news: 完成1亿美元C轮融资，由Insight Partners领投
latest_news_en: Closed $100M Series C led by Insight Partners
source_title: Pair of $400m rounds drive this week’s FinTech funding

evidence.quote: Numeral, an AI-driven sales tax compliance platform, has closed a $100m Series C round

Numeral provides sales tax compliance across nexus monitoring, registrations, tax calculation, filings, remittance and exemption certificate management. It also handles VAT and GST compliance in more than 90 countries and integrates with more than 40 billing, financial and ERP systems.

name: Flow Engineering
description: 为硬件设计提供AI工具的初创公司，通过AI代理自动将CAD图纸与产品需求、仿真结果和其他测试对齐，使硬件迭代速度接近软件开发
description_en: AI startup offering tools for hardware design that automatically align CAD drawings with product requirements, simulation results, and other testing through AI agents
why_matters: Flow Engineering获得了包括Valor Equity Partners、Atreides Management和Sequoia Capital等顶级投资机构的B轮融资，估值达到7.5亿美元，已获得Anduril、Rivian、Joby Aviation、通用汽车等多家知名硬件公司客户，在硬件设计AI化这一新兴领域建立了显著优势
why_matters_en: Flow Engineering secured Series B funding at $750M valuation from top-tier investors including Valor Equity Partners, Atreides Management, and Sequoia Capital, and has already attracted major hardware companies like Anduril, Rivian, Joby Aviation, and General Motors as customers in the emerging hardware design AI space
latest_news: 2026年9月30日宣布完成5000万美元B轮融资，估值7.5亿美元，由Valor Equity Partners和Atreides Management共同领投，Sequoia Capital跟投，前Sequoia合伙人Roelof Botha加入董事会
latest_news_en: Announced $50M Series B funding at $750M valuation on September 30, 2026, co-led by Valor Equity Partners and Atreides Management, with participation from Sequoia Capital and Roelof Botha joining the board
source_title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation

evidence.quote: Flow Engineering , a startup that offers AI tools for hardware design, has raised a $50 million Series B round at a $750 million valuation from some big-name investors
former Sequoia partner Roelof Botha, who invested as an individual investor. Botha has joined Flow's board, too.
Flow is tackling the difficulties of hardware design by offering AI agents that automatically align CAD drawings with product requirements, simulation results, and other testing

name: Restate
description: 为AI代理和后端应用提供持久性执行的新一代基础设施平台,使开发者能够专注于核心开发工作而无需处理底层管道
description_en: Next-generation infrastructure platform providing durable execution for AI agents and backend applications, allowing developers to focus on core work while handling plumbing automatically
why_matters: 由Apache Flink创始人打造,该开源技术已支撑银行、流媒体和SaaS领域的实时数据使用;A轮融资2000万美元,总融资2700万美元,已被数百家公司包括财富500强企业使用
why_matters_en: Built by creators of Apache Flink, the open-source technology underpinning real-time data use across banking, streaming media and SaaS sectors; raised $20M Series A with $27M total funding and used by hundreds of companies including Fortune 500 firms
latest_news: 2026年9月完成由Singular领投、Redpoint Ventures和Capital One Ventures参与的2000万美元A轮融资,将在旧金山设立商业中心扩展美国市场
latest_news_en: Raised $20M Series A led by Singular with participation from Redpoint Ventures and Capital One Ventures in September 2026, expanding to US market with new commercial hub in San Francisco

evidence.quote: The funding round in Berlin-founded Restate was led by European VC Singular, with participation from Redpoint Ventures and Capital One Ventures. Restate has now raised $27m in total
The founders of Restate created Apache Flink, an open-source technology that underpins real-time data use across banking, streaming media and software-as-a-service sectors
Restate, founded in 2024, says it's used by hundreds of companies, including Fortune 500 firms
